subject.title: Dashboard: workspace time-travel — history scrub, version diff, and widget→logbook blame

question: Should dashboard workspace time-travel stay in the bundled modular dashboard roadmap now, and should it wait behind the Wave 1 dashboard storage/provenance/security decisions?
rationale: The request is a new user-facing auditability surface layered on an unsettled dashboard stack, so automation cannot safely choose the product boundary or storage/privacy contract.

options.title: Keep Behind Dashboard Substrate
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the dashboard backend/UI/security contract to settle before accepting a time-travel implementation.

options.title: Move To External Experiment
options.body: Ask for the history/diff/blame surface to remain an external plugin or ClawHub experiment until maintainers promote the dashboard stack.

options.title: Defer This Child
options.body: Keep the roadmap tracker but explicitly defer or close this child if dashboard time-travel is not current product scope.

recommendation.title: Keep Behind Dashboard Substrate
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the dashboard backend/UI/security contract to settle before accepting a time-travel implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the merged Logbook and plugin-tab precedent that this issue depends on, making him the best history-backed product-routing owner from the inspected evidence.
